description: Finish the two-level (shape-9 clustered512) path precision squeeze. Parent d8a5c4d3 (brief-29) already converted the ORTH-gate GEMM to 3xTF32 (PROVEN SAFE: 0 fallback-flips over 3840 matrices, max|diff| 1.18e-5 << 4.58e-3 gate) but its standalone geomean was contention-noise-inconclusive -- this brief re-benches it QUIET to confirm AND stacks the next lever. THE NEW LEVER (brief-29 open #3): the two-level path's finishing Newton-Schulz block GEMMs (_ns_block: gram=Qf^T@Qf then Qf@(1.5I-0.5gram), currently true-FP32-SIMT allow_tf32=False on the RETURNED factors) -- brief-20 refuted PLAIN TF32 there (breaks orthonormality of the returned Q), but 3xTF32 (Ozaki hi+lo split, ~FP32-accurate, ~6e-6 relerr) was NEVER tried on the NS GEMMs. Convert the two NS-block GEMMs to _matmul_3xtf32; these run on the b640 kp-and-(n-kp)-column blocks (n^3-scale FP32-SIMT) so 3xTF32 tensor-core should shave ~1-2ms of shape9. CRITICAL SAFETY: unlike the gate GEMMs (which only decide pass/fail), the NS GEMMs produce the RETURNED Q -- so 3xTF32 error here directly affects the output orth. Verify the post-NS orth stays under gate AND the per-matrix fallback rate is unchanged across the 6 clustered reseeds (770004 + 770014/24/34/44/54); if 3xTF32 NS inflates orth past the gate (like plain TF32 did), keep FP32 NS and refute -- report the measured post-NS orth. Also QUIET re-bench to give the inherited orth-gate 3xTF32 a clean verdict (expected shape9 ~44-45ms if both land, geomean ~35,900-36,100 off this 8d30bf975 lineage). PURE-TORCH (lift _matmul_3xtf32); no nvcc; GPU-light. Per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback unchanged; do NOT touch the FP64 projector/CQR (brief-20 proved irreducible) or any non-shape-9 path; no 'stream' substring; forks d8a5c4d3. NOTE: this lineage is off 8d30bf975 (gate-trim), DISJOINT from brief-28's mixed peel -- a later combine folds it in.

t1: shape-9 two-level finishing NS block GEMMs (gram=Qf^T@Qf AND update=Qf@(1.5I-0.5*gram)) both FP32-SIMT -> 3xTF32 (_matmul_3xtf32 Ozaki hi+lo), on the RETURNED Q. SAFETY (brief crux, decisive, /tmp diagnostic across 6 clustered reseeds 770004+5, 3840 mats): post-NS orth ||Q^T Q - I||_1 (harness FP64 metric) reads orth_max=1.89e-4 (3xTF32) vs 1.90e-4 (FP32), max|diff|=3.23e-6, both ~24-400x below the 75*n*eps=4.58e-3 fallback trigger; 0 matrices >trigger (== FP32's 0), 0 >100*n*eps harness gate, TOTAL_FLIPS=0. 3xTF32 NS is SAFE on the returned factor (unlike plain TF32, brief-20). 39/39 validate. PERF: REGRESSES. Quiet apples-to-apples vs parent d8a5c4d3 (FP32 NS, freshly re-benched quiet 3x): shape-9 46157us -> 51047us (+4.9ms, +10.6%); geomean 36197us -> 36505us (+308us, +0.85%). nsys confirms the 2 NS GEMMs moved OFF simt_sgemm (64x128 ntn 1.99ms + 128x128 tnn 1.67ms GONE) ONTO TF32 tensor cores (s1688gemm 2.29+2.24+0.83+0.81ms) BUT the split does 3 bmm/GEMM = 6 bmm vs 2 sgemm, +1.9ms extra elementwise adds (Ah@Bh+Ah@Bl+Al@Bh), +1ms bit-mask -> net slower. REFUTES the brief's 'shave 1-2ms' hypothesis for BOTH-GEMM.

t2: shape-9 NS GRAM GEMM only (Qf^T@Qf) -> 3xTF32; update GEMM stays true FP32-SIMT. SAFE (diagnostic): gram-only post-NS orth_max=1.88e-4 vs FP32 1.90e-4, max|diff|=2.45e-6, 0 >trigger, 0 flips /3840 mats. PERF: still REGRESSES. Quiet 3x vs parent (FP32 NS): shape-9 46157->48347us (+2.2ms); geomean 36197->36322us (+125us). One 3xTF32 GEMM (3 bmm + bit-mask + 2 adds) replacing 1 FP32-SIMT sgemm is net slower even for the single (smaller, kp x kp output) gram GEMM.

t3: shape-9 NS UPDATE GEMM only (Qf@(1.5I-0.5*gram)) -> 3xTF32; gram GEMM stays true FP32-SIMT. SAFE (diagnostic): update-only post-NS orth_max=1.90e-4 vs FP32 1.90e-4, max|diff|=1.90e-6 (tightest of the 3 variants), 0 >trigger, 0 flips /3840 mats. PERF: still REGRESSES. Quiet 3x vs parent (FP32 NS): shape-9 46157->48659us (+2.5ms); geomean 36197->36364us (+167us). The update GEMM (n x kp output) as 3xTF32 (3 bmm + mask + 2 adds) replacing 1 FP32-SIMT sgemm is net slower. ALL THREE 3xTF32 NS variants (both/gram-only/update-only) REGRESS shape-9 by +2.2 to +4.9ms -- REFUTES the brief hypothesis; FP32-SIMT NS is fastest.

t4: KEEP FP32-SIMT NS (3xTF32 NS refuted as slower). Restored the block-NS GEMMs to true FP32-SIMT (parent d8a5c4d3's proven code) after t1/t2/t3 measured ALL THREE 3xTF32 conversions as shape-9 regressions. Executable code byte-identical to parent (verified: comment-only diff); only the _ns_block comment records the refutation. 39/39 validate. FINAL QUIET VERDICT (3 passes): geomean 36246.999/36270.948/36327.926us (best 36247), shape-9 46167.573/46245.674/46297.136us -- matches parent's own quiet re-bench (geomean ~36197, shape-9 ~46157, freshly measured this brief) within <0.3% noise. This ALSO gives the INHERITED orth-gate-3xTF32 change (brief-29) its clean verdict: it is NEUTRAL vs the 8d30bf975 lineage baseline on a quiet bench (brief-29's 36222/36255 were contention-inflated; the true quiet value is ~36200-36280, at/below 8d30bf975's ~36216). nsys t4 == parent: NS back on simt_sgemm (64x128 ntn 1.99ms + 128x128 tnn 1.67ms), orth-gate on TF32 tensor cores, FP64 projector/CQR untouched. Profile saved for follow-up briefs forking b676cbc3.

DONE brief-32 (4 trials). Branch HEAD b676cbc33d441a5562a84a66355cd78289bdf442, best metric 36246.999us (== parent, FP32 NS kept). Working tree clean, 39/39 validate, no 'stream'.

TWO DELIVERABLES:

(1) 3xTF32 NS -- REFUTED as a speedup, but PROVEN SAFE. Converted the two-level finishing block-NS GEMMs (_ns_block: gram=Qf^T@Qf, update=Qf@(1.5I-0.5gram)) from FP32-SIMT to 3xTF32, in all three combinations. SAFETY (the brief crux -- these feed the RETURNED Q, not a gate): /tmp diagnostic across 6 clustered reseeds (770004 + 770014/24/34/44/54, b640, 3840 matrices) measured post-NS orth ||Q^T Q - I||_1 in FP64 (the exact harness metric): FP32-NS orth_max 1.90e-4; 3xTF32-BOTH 1.89e-4 (max|diff| 3.23e-6), gram-only 1.88e-4 (2.45e-6), update-only 1.90e-4 (1.90e-6). ALL: 0 matrices over the 75*n*eps=4.58e-3 fallback trigger (== FP32's 0), 0 over the 100*n*eps harness gate, TOTAL_FLIPS=0. So 3xTF32 does NOT inflate the returned Q's orth and does NOT raise fallbacks -- it is SAFE (plain TF32 broke this per brief-20; 3xTF32's ~6e-6 relerr holds). BUT SLOWER on every variant (quiet 3x, apples-to-apples vs a fresh quiet parent re-bench): shape-9 46157us -> both 51047 (+4.9ms), gram-only 48347 (+2.2ms), update-only 48659 (+2.5ms); geomean 36197 -> +308/+125/+167us. nsys root cause: each 3xTF32 GEMM = 3 bmm (TF32 s1688gemm tensor-core, ~6.2ms total) + a bit-mask (~1ms) + 2 elementwise adds (~1.9ms) REPLACING 1 FP32-SIMT sgemm; that 6-bmm+overhead bundle exceeds the ~3.7ms FP32-SIMT NS GEMMs it displaces. The 2-chained-GEMM NS is the opposite regime from brief-29's single one-shot n x n orth-gate Gram (where 3xTF32 won). t4 restores FP32-SIMT NS (fastest); executable code is byte-identical to parent (comment-only diff records the refutation).

(2) INHERITED orth-gate-3xTF32 (brief-29) -- CLEAN QUIET VERDICT: NEUTRAL. brief-29's 36222/36255 were contention-inflated (<1%, inconclusive). Freshly re-benched quiet 3x, the parent (= the orth-gate-3xTF32 code) is geomean 36172.8/36200.2/36219.1us (~36197), shape-9 46112/46138/46221us (~46157) -- at/below the 8d30bf975 lineage's ~36216. So the orth-gate-3xTF32 change is safe + validated + on tensor cores at NO geomean cost (it neither helps nor hurts the geomean measurably; its ~1.5-2ms shape-9 saving is within shape-9 run noise). It should stay.

NET: this brief found NO improvement over parent d8a5c4d3 (36197us quiet); FP32-SIMT NS is confirmed fastest and is kept. The precision-squeeze lever on the two-level path's GEMMs is now measured to be exhausted for the two NS GEMMs specifically -- 3xTF32 helps a SINGLE one-shot Gram (orth-gate) but not the chained NS pair.

OPEN directions I did NOT pursue (manager's call):
 (a) shape-9 is now FP64-floor-bound: the profile shows FP64 d884gemm projector+block-Grams (~34%: 15.8+8.6+8.3+1.3%) + batch_trsm_right FP64 CQR solves (12.4%) + potrf (~3.5%) = ~50% irreducible FP64 (brief-20 refuted every reduced-precision projector/CQR). Breaking this needs an ALGORITHMIC departure from the FP64 CholeskyQR (e.g. a direct eigenbasis refinement or block-SVD that avoids the ill-conditioned Gram), not a dtype flip.
 (b) One FP32-SIMT simt_sgemm 128x64x16 nnn (2.93ms, 6.5%) is the LARGEST single non-FP64 shape-9 kernel and is NOT an NS GEMM (it survived every NS variant unchanged) -- I did not trace which op it is; identifying + accelerating it could trim shape-9 without touching the refuted NS.
 (c) shape-9 (~46ms) is a SMALL geomean term. The largest uncracked terms dominate the run-wide gap: shape 11 lapack_dense_even512 ~207ms, shape 6 mixed512 ~168ms, shape 8 rankdef512 ~93ms, shape 3 dense512 ~81ms -- all n>=512 cuSOLVER-floor dense shapes, untouched by this shape-9-focused lineage. That is the lever toward #1, not further shape-9 precision squeezing.
 (d) The Ozaki split's bit-mask + 2 adds are ~2.9ms of overhead per NS pass; a FUSED 3xTF32 kernel (or reusing the shared Qf hi/lo split across the gram+update GEMMs) could cut that -- but even at zero overhead the 6 TF32 GEMMs (~6.2ms) still exceed the 2 FP32-SIMT GEMMs (~3.7ms), so this is unlikely to flip the verdict.
